name: Don
summary: Four-player partnership trick-taking game where trump counters and game points race to 91 or 121 on a cribbage board.
rules_text: Four players in two crosswise partnerships are dealt 9 cards each from a 52-card pack. The player left of dealer pitches first, leading any suit which becomes trump for the deal. Play clockwise, follow suit if possible. Highest card of led suit wins unless trumped, then highest trump wins. Trick winner leads next. During play teams immediately peg points for trump counting cards and Fives won in tricks. After all tricks, count game points: Aces, Kings, Queens, Jacks and Tens taken. Team with higher total pegs 8 bonus points, in variants 6+1+1 or 5+1+1+1 for high, low and jack of trump. First side to reach 91 or 121 wins.
rating_reason: All Fours descendant partnership trick-taking, strategic.
